title: Paloma and the Aftermath
author: Theo Lockridge
blurb: Astrid Almeida, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
